results.name: coliseum --help
results.detail:
Usage: coliseum <command> [args...]

Commands:
  setup   Configure theme, auth and HQ mode
  launch  Launch Minecraft and the Foreman
  doctor  Diagnose your install and environment
  bridge  Run the agent <-> Minecraft bridge
  arena   Run the arena bridge

Run "coliseum <command> --help" for command-specific help.

Examples:
  coliseum setup --show
  coliseum launch
  coliseum doctor --help
  coliseum bridge --help

results.name: bridge --help
results.detail:
OpenClaw Bridge — Claude Code ↔ AgentCraft

Usage: node tools/bridge.mjs <command> [args]   (-h, --help, help)
Env: AGENTCRAFT_PORT (default 7878), AGENTCRAFT_TIMEOUT_MS (RPC timeout, default 15000)
Example: node tools/bridge.mjs status

Commands:
  status                        Team state overview (agents, tasks, cost)
  agents                        List agents and what they're doing
  goal "<text>" [--repo <name>] Submit a goal (optionally target a specific repo)
  tasks [goalId]                List tasks
  decisions                     List open decisions
  decide <id> <option> [text]   Answer a decision
  merge <id>                    Approve a merge decision
  diff <worktree>               Get diff for a worktree
  msg <agent|all> "<text>"      Message an agent
  repos                         List all registered repos (id, name, path, branch, dirty)
  cost                          Show total API cost so far
  repo-add <path>               Register a new repo
  watch                         Live event stream
  autopilot                     Auto-approve all permissions + merges (full autonomy)
  autopilot --no-merge          Auto-approve permissions only, pause on merges for review
  run "<goal>" [--autopilot]    Submit goal + watch + auto-approve in one command

results.name: arena --help
results.detail:
Coliseum Arena — Battle Royale Bridge

Usage: node tools/arena-bridge.mjs <command> [args]   (-h, --help, help)
Env: AGENTCRAFT_PORT (default 7878)
Example: node tools/arena-bridge.mjs simulate

Commands:
  start "<topic>" [--agents N]    Start a battle royale (default: 16 agents)
  simulate ["topic"]              Run a fake battle royale for visual testing (no AI needed)
  status                          Show arena state
  scoreboard                      Current rankings
  spectate                        Live commentary feed
  eliminate <id>                  Manually eliminate a combatant
  crown <id>                     Declare the champion
